title: Diabetes progression
subtitle: Predict disease progression one year after baseline
about: Ten baseline variables (age, sex, BMI, blood pressure and six serum measurements, mean-centred and scaled) for 442 patients. `progression` is a quantitative measure one year later.
source: B. Efron, T. Hastie, I. Johnstone, R. Tibshirani, Least Angle Regression, Annals of Statistics (2004). Distributed with scikit-learn.
